meta.description: Planner for secondary schools, higher education and vocational training: what exists today, and what comes next.

entete.accroche: Secondary schools, higher education, vocational training: here is what Planner already does for each, and what comes next.

collegeLycee.titre: The whole class, in one gesture.
collegeLycee.texte: Teachers take attendance and run their quizzes from Planner. Timetable calculation for middle and high schools is in preparation.

aujourdhui.texte: Pupils scan the projected code, or the teacher marks each one by hand: present, late or absent. Attendance is linked to the session.
Live in class, or at each pupil's own pace.
Rooms and their bookings, exams and their invigilation, room occupancy.
The teacher asks, the school office approves, the pupils concerned are notified.

bientot.texte: An account for parents, for one or several children.
Absences, grade entry and report cards.
The school's data, exported to your country's national platform. In Morocco, Massar is one example.
Planner in Arabic, as well as French and English.

superieur.titre: Programmes, groups and campuses, worked out together.
superieur.texte: For universities, specialised schools and BTS programmes: Planner works out the semester, then supports every session.

aujourdhui.texte: Each programme's lectures, tutorials and labs follow their groups and subgroups, and every refusal is explained.
Each campus has its rooms, and the travel time between campuses counts in the calculation.
Exam sessions, their rooms and their invigilation.
Attendance by QR code or by hand, live quizzes and games, with the same account.

bientot.texte: Grade entry and report cards, with LMD credits.
Students' internships, and the link with former students.

formation.texte: For training centres: a calculated timetable that you adjust as sessions go by.

aujourdhui.texte: Every calculation is kept as a version, and the timetable is only visible once published.
Rescheduling is tracked, the timetable exports as a PDF, and everyone adds it to their calendar.
Teachers, learners, groups and courses are imported from a CSV file.

bientot.texte: Applications through to enrolment, with nothing typed twice.
Certificates and attestations, with a code anyone can check.
